relationships.subject: AM281
relationships.evidence_quote: The effect of THC on mechanical PWT was abolished by AM281, but was unaffected by AM630

relationships.subject: AM630
relationships.evidence_quote: The effect of CBD on acetone responses was unaffected by AM281, but abolished by AM630

key_findings: Intrathecal THC and CBD reduced mechanical and cold allodynia in mouse CCI, synergistically in 1:1 combination, without cannabinoid side-effects.
THC effects required CB1 receptors; CBD effects were partly CB2-dependent.
